rationales: Eight months is longer than the typical red blood cell lifespan.

Two months is shorter than the typical red blood cell lifespan.
AB blood group is the universal recipient for red blood cell transfusions in the ABO system.
O blood group is generally the universal donor, not the universal recipient.
B blood group cannot receive blood from all ABO groups.
A blood group cannot receive blood from all ABO groups.
Biology is the scientific study of life.
Cell biology studies cells, a branch of biology.
Physiology studies how organisms and their parts function.
Botany studies plants, a branch of biology.
A habitat is the place where an organism lives, not the global zone inhabited by life.
A population is a group of members of one species in an area.
A community consists of populations of different species living together.
The biosphere is the part of Earth inhabited by organisms and their communities.
Observation is the first step in solving a biological problem.
A hypothesis is proposed after observations and problem identification.
Deduction follows the formulation of a hypothesis.
An experiment tests a hypothesis and is not the first step.
Kingdom is a broad classification rank, not the basic unit.
Phylum is a classification rank above class and order.
Genus groups closely related species and is not the basic unit.
Species is the basic unit of classification.
Diffusion is net movement from higher to lower concentration.
Osmosis is the movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane.
Passive transport moves substances down their concentration gradient without energy.
Active transport moves substances against their concentration gradient using energy.
Carbohydrates are not the principal product synthesized by rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Ribosomes on rough endoplasmic reticulum synthesize proteins.
Lipids are mainly synthesized by smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
Vitamin synthesis is not the main function of rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Mitosis produces two daughter cells, not eight.
Mitosis does not produce six daughter cells.
Mitosis produces two daughter cells, not four.
Mitosis divides one cell into two daughter cells.
Bile emulsifies fats but does not digest starch.
Amylase breaks starch down into simpler sugars.
Lipase digests fats, not starch.
Protease digests proteins, not starch.
Kinetic energy is energy of motion, not energy stored in food bonds.
Food stores chemical potential energy in its bonds.
Heat is a form of energy released during energy transformations, not the stored energy described here.
Solar energy is energy from the Sun, not the energy stored in food bonds.
Eight to nine days is narrower than the commonly given platelet lifespan range.
Seven to nine days is the expected average lifespan range for platelets in this curriculum.
Six to seven days is shorter than the expected range.
Seven to eight days is narrower than the expected range.
A thrombus is a blood clot formed within a vessel, not myocardial infarction itself.
An embolus is a traveling obstruction in a blood vessel, not myocardial infarction itself.
The myocardium is the heart muscle; infarction refers to tissue death due to interrupted blood supply.
Tissue death from interrupted blood supply is an infarction; myocardial infarction affects heart muscle.
Histology is the study of tissues.
Morphology is the study of form and structure.
Embryology is the study of embryos and development.
Entomology is the scientific study of insects.
Organelles are structures inside cells, not groups of cells.
A tissue is a group of similar cells performing a common function.
An organ consists of different tissues working together.
An organ system consists of organs working together.
